messages.content: Can you retrieve the analysis trail for the vulnerability ef903ac-893-f00 within component AB1010CD of the project SUPERFANCY?

function.name: acl_api_add_mapping
function.description: Adds an Access Control List (ACL) mapping to define permissions for users or groups. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user for whom the ACL mapping will be added.

resource_id.description: The unique identifier of the resource to which access is being controlled.

permissions.description: A list of permissions to be granted, such as ['read', 'write', 'delete'].

expires_on.description: The date on which the ACL mapping expires, in the format of 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

function.name: acl_api_delete_mapping
function.description: Removes an Access Control List (ACL) mapping between a specified team and project by their UUIDs. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

teamUuid.description: The universally unique identifier (UUID) of the team for which the ACL mapping is to be removed.

projectUuid.description: The UUID of the project associated with the team whose ACL mapping is to be deleted.

function.name: acl_api_AclApi_retrieve_projects
function.description: Retrieve a list of projects assigned to a specified team, with options to exclude inactive or non-root projects. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the team for which to retrieve project mappings.

excludeInactive.description: If true, inactive projects will not be included in the response.

onlyRoot.description: If true, only root projects will be returned, excluding any child projects.

function.name: analysis_api_AnalysisApi_retrieve_analysis
function.description: Retrieves the trail of analysis for a given vulnerability within the specified component of a project. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

project.description: The UUID of the project for which the analysis trail is to be retrieved.

component.description: The UUID of the component involved in the analysis within the specified project.

vulnerability.description: The UUID of the vulnerability for which the analysis trail is to be retrieved.

message.content: I’m ready to retrieve the analysis trail, but I’ll need the UUIDs for the project, component, and vulnerability. Could you provide those IDs (or confirm that the names you gave are the UUIDs)?
